battle.name: 竇建德攻幽州之戰
battle.brief: 武德初年，竇建德併有河北後揮軍北上，圍攻幽州，總管羅藝據城固守，攻方屢攻不克，聞唐援軍將至遂解圍而去，幽州終歸唐有。卡面兵器為希臘重步兵（Hoplite），成形於公元前五世紀的希臘城邦，比本役早一千一百餘年；其以圓盾結陣、盾肩相接的戰法，與守軍結陣自保的樣態最為相類。

kit.name: 希臘重步兵
kit.history: 方陣的重心不是個人，是互相遮蔽。盾牌接在一起時，一支軍隊的正面比一個人結實。

countries: 這場戰爭是武德初年河北霸權與北方藩鎮在幽州一線的正面碰撞。進攻方是竇建德以河北為基地建立起來的夏政權：竇建德是河北人，舊唐書作貝州武城人、另說河間觀津，早年在河北抗隋的起義軍中擔任張金稱部將，武德元年併吞張金稱的部眾與河北各處割據者，盡有冀、兗、豫一帶州縣，控弦之士以數十萬計，河北的馬匹與屯田才是這個政權真正的立國之本；夏軍以騎兵為骨架，攻城器械齊備，又與洛陽的王世充相互呼應，聲勢極盛。防守方是幽州總管羅藝所部：羅藝為襄陽人，其父羅彥曾任隋朝郡守，羅藝以本部曲兵守燕雲之地，據幽州城與范陽、薊縣一線的塞障，倚河渠、屯田與城壘自守；唐廷在河北的州縣與秦王府的班底是他背後的支援，羅藝受封燕王之後，幽州更成為唐朝北方防線的支點。第三方並非旁觀：王世充在洛陽與竇建德互結，以竇建德為夏公；劉黑闥等夏軍將領在河北內地游騎策應；北面則有劉武周、梁師都與突厥諸部牽制唐軍，使唐廷無法以主力北上。整場衝突的實質，是竇建德要在河北稱霸的基礎上向北開門，奪取唐廷在燕雲的前哨。
countriesEn: This war was an open collision between the Hebei-based power of Dou Jiande and the northern garrison of the Yan-yun region on the Youzhou line in the first years of the Wude era. The attacking side was the Xia regime Dou Jiande had built on Hebei: Dou was a native of Wucheng in Beizhou and first made his name as a commander of Zhang Kecheng among the peasant insurgents who rose against the Sui in Hebei; in the first year of Wude he absorbed Zhang's followers and the lesser warlords scattered over the province, taking commanderies in Ji, Yan and Yu, with a force of several hundred thousand under arms, and it was the horses and the garrison fields of Hebei, not the numbers of men alone, that formed the real foundation of his state. The Xia army was built around cavalry and came equipped for siege, and it was in alliance with Wang Shichong at Luoyang, so its prestige was at its height. The defence was held by the troops of Luo Yi, military governor of Youzhou. Luo was a man from Xiangyang whose father Luo Yan had served the Sui as a commandery governor; Luo held Yan-yun with the soldiers he had raised, using the city of Youzhou and the barrier line of Fanyang and Ji County, and depended on rivers, canals, garrison fields and the walls for his subsistence. Behind him stood the Tang commanderies of Hebei and the administrative core of the Prince of Qin's establishment, and once Luo Yi was enfeoffed as Prince of Yan, Youzhou became a hinge of the Tang northern defence. Third parties were not idle: Wang Shichong at Luoyang was in alliance with Dou Jiande and called him the Duke of Xia; Xia commanders such as Liu Heita rode through the interior of Hebei as raiding columns; and to the north, Liu Wuzhou, Liang Shidu and the Turkic tribes held Tang troops pinned down, so that the court could not spare its main strength for the north. At bottom, this conflict was Dou Jiande trying, on the strength of his mastery of Hebei, to open a door in the north and seize the Tang court's forward post in Yan-yun.
people: 竇建德是這場戰爭唯一的主角，字廣德，河北人，舊唐書作貝州武城人、另說家出河間觀津，出身鄉里，早年在河北抗隋的起義軍中擔任張金稱部將，武德元年乘亂併吞河北勢力，自稱冀王，兩年後進位夏王。他起兵之後禮遇舊屬、收攏流亡、重用劉黑闥一類驍將，麾下多河北舊部與北方歸附的騎兵，河北是他唯一來處的根據地。防守一方的核心是幽州總管羅藝，字子軒，襄陽人，父羅彥為隋代郡守，羅藝以本部軍人保燕雲，竇建德來犯時堅守孤城不拔，數次挫其鋒頭；武德三年羅藝以幽州歸唐，受封燕王，總幽州兵事，其後曾起兵反唐，事敗而亡。唐廷方面，高祖李淵以中樞控制河北戰局，命李世勣等宿將率軍在河北與夏軍周旋，又以羅藝為北面藩屏；南面則有李世民於洛陽一線纏住王世充，使竇建德無法傾盡兵力北向，而能放手一搏。
peopleEn: Dou Jiande was the single protagonist of this campaign. His courtesy name was Guangde, and he was a native of Wucheng in Beizhou, born into a local family; he first made his name as a commander of Zhang Kecheng among the peasant insurgents who rose against the Sui in Hebei, and in the first year of Wude he used the disorder to swallow up the whole of Hebei, taking the title of Prince of Ji and, two years later, advancing to the title of Prince of Xia. Once in power he treated his old subordinates generously, gathered in fugitives, and employed fierce officers of the stamp of Liu Heita, while much of his army consisted of former Hebei soldiers and of riders who had come north from the frontier; Hebei was the only base he had. The core of the defence was Luo Yi, military governor of Youzhou, courtesy name Zixuan, a native of Xiangyang whose father Luo Yan had been a Sui commandery governor. Luo held Yan-yun on the strength of the troops he had raised, and when Dou Jiande came against him he held his isolated city and several times checked the assault. In the third year of Wude he handed Youzhou over to the Tang, was enfeoffed as Prince of Yan and given authority over the Youzhou commandery; he later rose in revolt against the Tang and was destroyed. On the Tang side, the Gaozu Li Yuan steered the Hebei theatre from the central command at Taiyuan, ordered veteran commanders such as Li Shiji to operate against the Xia forces in Hebei, and treated Luo Yi as a screen in the north; in the south, Li Shimin was pinning Wang Shichong down at Luoyang, so that Dou Jiande could not commit his whole army northward and was able to try his hand at Youzhou.
kits: 卡面兵器是希臘重步兵（Hoplite），成形於公元前五世紀的希臘城邦，比本役早一千一百餘年，在中國史冊上從未出現，因此不會有希臘人站在幽州城下。牠之所以值得放上這張卡，是因為它示範了一種與本役守軍最為相類的戰鬥樣態：以圓盾（aspis）列陣，盾牌彼此遮蔽，人肩相接，隊形正面比任何單兵都要結實，方陣不求速進而求不散。希臘重步兵的全套裝備是青銅胸甲（thorax）、頭盔、護腿、長矛（dory）與短劍（xiphos），講究的是整體重量與遮蔽。同一時期真正決定幽州攻防的，仍是唐夏兩軍的唐制武備：鎧以明光鎧、兜鍪、鎧裙為主，長兵器有馬槊、陌刀與長槍，弓弩用竹木複合的弓、臂長弩與床弩；攻城一方備雲梯、撞車、穴車，飛石與火油火箭用以焚燒城門與城樓；守方則倚城垣、礌石、井欄，士卒緣梯上下。馬匹方面，夏軍騎兵多用河北與北方邊地所產之馬，並以輜重車隊隨軍運糧；可以看見，希臘方陣的遮蔽觀念在唐代是用另一套技術實現的：重步兵的功能被吸收進甲士與弩手混編的守城步兵，衝鋒的功能則由重騎與步騎混編的突擊集團承擔。
kitsEn: The card face is the Greek hoplite, a formation that took shape among the Greek poleis in the fifth century BC, more than eleven hundred years before this war, and that never appears in any Chinese history, so no Greek soldier ever stood beneath the walls of Youzhou. It earns the card because it demonstrates a mode of combat closest to that of the garrison here: the round aspis shields were locked edge to edge, shoulder to shoulder, so that the front of a formation was far tougher than any single man, and the phalanx sought cohesion rather than speed. The full kit of the Greek heavy infantry was the bronze thorax, helmet and greaves, the long dory spear and the short xiphos sword, all of it built around mass and cover. What actually decided the siege of Youzhou was, of course, the Tang-style armament of both armies: armour of bright mitre plate, helmets and tassets; long weapons of the cavalry lance, the pao-dao and the long spear; bows and crossbows of composite bamboo and wood, including the long-armed crossbow and the bed crossbow. The besiegers brought scaling ladders, battering rams, mobile siege sheds, and stone-throwing and fire-lashing rockets to burn the gates and the gate towers; the defenders relied on the wall, on stones dropped from the parapet and on the wells, with the troops moving up and down the ladders inside. As for horses, the Xia cavalry rode mounts from Hebei and from the northern frontier, and baggage wagons followed the army with the grain. One can see how the Greek idea of cover was reinvented in the Tang: the function of the heavy infantry was absorbed into garrison infantry drawn from armoured men and crossbowmen, while the function of the charge was carried by shock cavalry and mixed foot-and-horse striking groups.
tactics: 竇建德的戰術意圖很清楚：以圍點、斷糧、迫援三步，取代硬碰硬的野戰。他不急於強攻幽州城，而是先以大軍駐紮城下，切斷范陽、薊縣一線由河間、涿郡方向運來的糧道與鹽鐵商路，再派騎兵四出抄掠郡縣、偵探唐方援軍的動向；同時放出夏公兵臨幽燕的消息，希望不戰而使唐廷承認河北既成事實，必要時再以精騎挑戰，誘使守軍出城，在城下曠野殲其步卒。守方羅藝的應對是以城為本：不出城爭野戰，只在城南與東面要道佈置弩陣，居高臨下覆蓋城門前的開闊地，夏軍騎兵一旦逼近即遭密集箭矢與長槊穿刺；唐方援軍北上的消息一傳出，竇建德立即解圍，避免腹背受敵。整體而言，這是一場以時間換空間的攻守：攻城方靠的是河北人力物力的總量與騎兵機動，守城方靠的是城垣堅固、糧秣自足與援軍在側，最終攻方在時間表上先輸一步。
tacticsEn: Dou Jiande's tactical intent was clear: rather than a head-on field battle, he meant to work in three steps, blockade, cut of supply, and forced relief. He was in no hurry to assault the city outright. He first parked the bulk of his army beneath the walls, cut the grain road and the salt and iron traffic that reached Fanyang and Ji County from the direction of Hejian and Zhuojun, and then sent riders out to harry the commanderies and to scout the movements of any Tang relief column. At the same time he spread the word that the Duke of Xia's army was at Yan-yun, in the hope that the Tang court would concede the fait accompli in Hebei without a fight, and if necessary he sent elite horse to provoke the garrison into leaving the city so that it could be destroyed in the open ground below the walls. Luo Yi's answer was to make the city his base: he refused to give battle in the field, but deployed crossbow lines to the south and east of the city and along the main approaches, covering the open ground before the gates from above, so that any Xia cavalry that came close was met with a shower of arrows and long thrusting spears. The moment word came that a Tang relief army was moving north, Dou Jiande lifted the siege at once rather than risk being taken between two fronts. The whole contest was in effect an exchange of time for space: the besieger relied on the sheer weight of Hebei's manpower and supplies and on cavalry mobility, the besieged on the strength of the walls, on provisions of their own and on a relief army close at hand; in the end the besieger lost the race on time.
data: 關於本役的具體數字，諸史記載有限，可以確定的只有以下幾項尺度。竇建德在河北的總兵力，舊唐書與資治通鑑以擁兵百萬、雄踞河北一類的概況語形容，屬史筆的量級之語，並非點驗名冊；實際投入幽州方向的兵馬，諸史未載確數，據其後板渚、虎牢關兩役出動的規模推想，約在數萬至數十萬之間。守軍方面，幽州是隋代北方重鎮，城中屯兵與府兵番上之數均無明確記載，故不可據以推算。地理尺度可以估算：由河北腹地冀州、魏州一線循道路北上至幽州，約六百里，途中多丘陵與隘口，故大軍需十數日方可抵近城下；自幽州再北即入塞外草原，是竇建德勢力難以延伸之處。時間上，圍城歷時逾月，其間竇建德至少再攻幽州一次，資治通鑑記武德二年竇建德再圍幽州，與本次前後相接，故此役常被合稱為竇建德攻幽州之戰。戰果方面，竇建德無攻城之功，羅藝亦無大損，雙方皆無可確證的斬獲數字；可確定的損失發生在一年之後的板渚與虎牢關，李世民於板渚擊破夏軍、俘虜數萬，竇建德再於虎牢關被擒，河北才重新歸於一統。
dataEn: Precise figures for this campaign are scarce, and only the following measures can be set down with confidence. Dou Jiande's total strength in Hebei is described in the Jiu Tangshu and the Zizhi Tongjian in general terms such as a hundred thousand men under arms and mastery of the north, which is a historian's sense of scale rather than a muster roll; the number actually committed against Youzhou is nowhere recorded exactly, and judging from the size of the armies he put in the field later at Banbu and Hulao, it lay somewhere between several tens of thousands and a hundred thousand or so. On the defensive side, Youzhou was a major Sui fortress in the north, and neither the garrison within the walls nor the men of the rotating service levies are recorded, so no calculation can be built on them. Geography can be measured: from the Hebei interior around Jizhou and Weizhou, a road march north to Youzhou runs roughly six hundred li, and the way is broken by hills and defiles, so a great host needed more than ten days to close on the city; north of Youzhou lay the steppe, which was where Dou's reach could not be extended. In time, the blockade lasted more than a month, and Dou attacked Youzhou at least once more: the Zizhi Tongjian records his renewed siege in the second year of Wude, immediately following this one, which is why the two are usually treated as a single campaign. On results, Xia took nothing from the walls and Luo Yi lost nothing worth counting, so no casualty figure can be verified on either side; the losses that can be verified came a year later at Banbu and Hulao, where Li Shimin broke the Xia army and took tens of thousands of prisoners, and where Dou Jiande was himself captured, after which Hebei returned to a single rule.
cause: 竇建德為何要在武德初年揮師北上，答案藏在他整合河北之後的處境。竇建德以起義軍起家，兩年間吞併河北大小割據者，兵眾雖多，土地卻多為河北諸郡的殘破州縣，能徵發的丁口與糧秣有限，而河北四戰之地一旦與唐廷進入持久戰，消耗只會與日俱增。幽州正卡在河北通往塞北的門戶上：它一旦落在夏軍之手，唐廷在河北的州縣便多了一面可恃的北方屏障，竇建德也可以把勢力從黃河以北推向燕雲，把騎兵活動的邊境利益握在掌中。從防守方看，羅藝據幽州，扼守范陽、薊、漁陽一線，正是唐廷北面最前的一顆棋子；只要羅藝一日不服，竇建德便無法宣稱已盡有河北。而王世充在洛陽遭李世民步步進逼，不斷遣使求援，竇建德若坐視洛陽失守，河北即暴露在唐軍正面之下，因此他必須趁唐廷主力被洛陽吸住、主將北援兵力尚可抽調的窗口內，先取幽州。
causeEn: Why Dou Jiande marched north in the first years of Wude is answered by the situation he found himself in after unifying Hebei. Dou had risen out of an insurrection, and in two years he had swallowed every lesser warlord of the province; his numbers of men were large, but his territory was a patchwork of worn-out Hebei commanderies, so the labour and grain he could draw upon were limited, and once Hebei was locked in a war of attrition with the Tang court the drain would only grow worse with every month. Youzhou sat exactly on the gate from Hebei to the steppe: had it fallen to the Xia army, the Tang commanderies of Hebei would have gained a northern shield, and Dou could have pushed his power north of the Yellow River into Yan-yun, keeping the frontier pastures of his riders in his own hands. From the other side, Luo's Youzhou, holding Fanyang, Ji and Yuyang, was the Tang court's foremost piece on the northern board; so long as Luo did not submit, Dou could not claim to have Hebei entire. Meanwhile Wang Shichong at Luoyang was being pressed step by step by Li Shimin and kept sending envoys begging for help; if Dou sat back and watched Luoyang fall, Hebei would be left exposed to the Tang army on his front. He therefore had to strike at Youzhou in the window in which the Tang main force was absorbed at Luoyang and a northern detachment could still be spared.
impact: 這一役沒有分出勝負，卻改變了河北與燕雲兩地的力量對比。竇建德未能攻下幽州，夏軍在北方第一次遭遇硬碰硬的抵抗，銳氣與士氣都受挫；他其後揮師南下救援王世充，先在板渚折於李世民，再在虎牢關全軍崩潰，同年閏五月被押解長安，夏政權至此覆亡，河北重歸唐廷一統。幽州方向的戰略結果同樣重要：竇建德屢攻不克，羅藝反而在武德三年以幽州降唐，受封燕王，總幽州兵馬，唐廷自此取得燕雲十六州最北的一枚棋子，把防線從河北推到塞下，北方邊軍與河北州縣之間有了明確的聯防樞紐。從更長的時間看，隋末以來幽燕地區的割據狀態至此告一段落，唐朝對契丹、靺鞨、突厥的邊防經營以幽州為北端，後來安史之亂時史思明據范陽、藩鎮割據河北的格局，也在此時已隱然埋下伏線。兵器史上則有一點值得留意：這場戰爭是唐制重裝步兵與馬槊、陌刀體系的一次大規模實戰，與希臘重步兵的方陣傳統毫無血緣關係，卻同樣證明了遮蔽與結陣在守城戰中的價值。
impactEn: Neither side won a decision here, yet the balance of power in Hebei and in Yan-yun changed. Dou Jiande failed to take Youzhou; Xia met hard resistance in the north for the first time and both its morale and its momentum suffered. Turning south to relieve Wang Shichong, he was broken by Li Shimin at Banbu and then crushed at Hulao, and in the intercalary fifth month of the same year he was taken to Chang'an, the Xia state came to an end, and Hebei returned to a single Tang authority. The strategic outcome in the north mattered just as much: after repeated failures, Luo Yi surrendered Youzhou to the Tang in the third year of Wude, was enfeoffed as Prince of Yan and took charge of the Youzhou forces; the court thus gained the northernmost piece of the sixteen prefectures of Yan-yun, pushed its defensive line from Hebei up to the frontier, and gave the northern frontier troops and the Hebei commanderies a clear hinge for their joint defence. In the longer run, the period of separatism in the Youzhou and Yanyang region that had run since the end of the Sui came to an end, and the Tang administration of the frontier against Khitan, Mohe and Turks was anchored at Youzhou at its northern tip; the later arrangement, in which Shi Siming held Fanyang during the An Lushan rebellion and in which military governors carved Hebei into their own power, had already been foreshadowed here. For the history of arms there is one point worth noting: this campaign was a large-scale field test of the Tang heavy infantry system of spear, lance and pao-dao, which had no blood relationship whatever to the Greek hoplite phalanx, yet demonstrated just as plainly the value of cover and close formation in a siege.
result: 結果是攻方失利、守方保住城池。竇建德大軍屯兵幽州城下，築營圍城，屢攻不克，糧道又遭唐方與地方武力的不斷騷擾，士卒疲憊；當唐廷援軍將要北上的消息傳出，他審時度勢，選擇解圍而去，避免在幽州城下兩面受敵，河北稱霸的格局並未因此崩解。羅藝守住了幽州，城池、府庫與屯田完好，武德三年他以幽州歸唐，被封為燕王，幽州自此納入唐朝版圖，成為北方軍鎮之一，拱衛河北與塞南。竇建德退兵之後轉向洛陽，試圖以援軍拖住李世民、挽救王世充，結果在板渚被唐騎擊破、士卒被俘數萬，銳氣盡失；同年閏五月，他率軍再攻虎牢關，終被李世民生擒，傳首長安，河北群雄最後的割據勢力就此清除。竇建德攻幽州之戰因此被視為唐夏爭霸的轉折點：北方門戶未失，而進攻方的元氣已在城下與南線連番消耗殆盡。
resultEn: The result was failure for the besieger and a city saved for the defenders. Dou Jiande's host sat beneath Youzhou, built its camp and walled the city in, but repeated assaults failed, the supply line was continually harried by Tang forces and by local armed men, and the soldiers were exhausted; when word reached him that a Tang relief army was about to move north, he weighed the situation and chose to lift the siege rather than risk being caught at Youzhou with the enemy on two sides, and the structure of his supremacy in Hebei did not collapse. Luo Yi kept Youzhou, with its walls, its storehouses and its garrison fields intact; in the third year of Wude he handed the city to the Tang, was made Prince of Yan, and Youzhou from that point belonged to the Tang realm and became one of its northern commands, covering Hebei and the country south of the frontier. After withdrawing, Dou turned on Luoyang and tried to pin Li Shimin down with a relief army in order to save Wang Shichong, only to be broken by Tang horse at Banbu with tens of thousands of his men taken prisoner and his spirit failing; in the intercalary fifth month of the same year he attacked Hulao once more and was taken alive by Li Shimin, his head sent to Chang'an, and the last separatist force in Hebei was removed. Dou Jiande's attack on Youzhou is therefore treated as the turning point of the Tang-Xia struggle: the northern gate was not lost, while the attacker's vigour had been spent away in turn beneath the city and on the southern front.
